verses.text: Ix b'at winhaj Roboam t'a Siquem, yujto ata' molanxo ek' masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel ay t'a stojolal norte yik syak'ankanoch winh heb' sreyalok.
Ix k'och spekal jun tik t'a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat ayik ayek' winh t'a Egipto, yujto elnak lemnaj winh t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix schekan heb' israel chi' to b'at ik'chajkot winh. Axo yik ix jawi winh, ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal lolonel yet' winhaj Roboam chi'. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik:

--Ha winh a mam te ek'al ya munlajel ix yak' winh ko k'ulej. Axo tiknaik jun, sko nib'ej to tzik'el jab'ok juntzanh munlajel te ya chi' t'a kib'anh, yik ol kak'och ko b'a t'a yalanh a mandar, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Roboam chi': --Ha tiknaik paxanhek, chab'ejto tzex jax in eyila', swalan t'ayex tas tz'aji, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix pax heb' anima chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' munlajnak yet' winh smam winh chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal junok razón tzeyak' t'ayin, yik tzin pakan slolonel heb' anima tik? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Tato tza nib'ej tzak' serwil jun chonhab' tik, wach' tzutej tak'wok a b'a t'a heb', yik wach' ol yak'nhejoch sb'a heb' t'a yalanh a mandar, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Palta maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh ichamtak winak chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'anxi winh t'a juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak winak jun ix q'uib' winh yet'ok, heb' winh ix och t'a yopisio yet' winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas junok razón tzeyak' t'ayin, tas ol wutok in pakan slolonel heb' anima chi'? Snib'ej heb' swik'el jab'ok munlajel yet' juntzanhxo tas aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh in mam, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh kelemtak chi' t'a winh: --Ha heb' tz'alan chi' to tzik'el jab'ok munlajel aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh a mam chi', al t'a heb' icha tik: Ya munlajel b'aj yak'nak ex och winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto syail b'aj ol ex wak'ochi.

Al yutejnak eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto ol wutej yalil eyikatz chi'. Ha winh in mam chi', anhej t'a nok' tz'uum smak'nak ex winh, a inxo pax tik, a nok' tz'uum ayoch k'een k'een t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xa chi t'a heb', xchi heb' winh kelemtak chi'.
Axo t'a schab'jial chi', ix jax winhaj Jeroboam yet' masanil heb' chonhab' israel yil winhaj rey Roboam chi', icha ix aj yalan winh.
Axo winh rey chi', maj yal-laj winh icha ix aj yalan heb' winh ichamtak winak chi', palta te chuk ix yutej winh spakan t'a heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ha tas ix yal heb' winh kelemtak, a ix yal winh t'a heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Al yutejnak eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto ol wutej yalil eyikatz chi'. Ha winh in mam chi', anhej t'a nok' tz'uum smak'nak ex winh, a inxo pax tik, a nok' tz'uum ayoch k'een k'een t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xchi winh t'a heb' anima chi'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' israel chi' to maj schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal heb', yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Malaj kalan kik t'a yinhtilal winhaj David. Malaj junok makan onh tzonh kan yet' yinhtilal winhaj Isaí. Konh paxek t'a ko pat. Olxo yilkan sb'a winhaj David yet' yinhtilal tas sk'ulej, xchi heb'. Ix chekjib'at winhaj Adoram yuj winh rey chi' yik b'at lolon winh yet' heb' israel chi', yujto a winh ay yopisio skuchb'an heb' munlajwum yowalil smunlaji. Axo heb' israel chi', ix k'e somnaj heb', ix sjulk'enancham winh heb'. Axo yik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Roboam chi', ix k'e winh t'a yol skarruaje, ix kot lemnaj winh t'a Jerusalén. Ixlajwi chi', haxo masanil makanhil heb' israel ay t'a stojolal norte ix pax heb' t'a spat. Axonhej t'a heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá ix yak' reyal winhaj Roboam chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj yik'anel sb'a heb' israel t'a yol sk'ab' yinhtilal winhaj David. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winh schekab', haton winhaj Ahías aj Silo, yuj winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' israel to ayxo ek' winhaj Jeroboam t'a yol schonhab' heb', ix schekan heb' awtajkot winh yik sch'oxan sb'a winh t'a yichanh heb'. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' sreyalok. Axonhej heb' yinhtilal Judá ix kan yet' winhaj Roboam yixchikin winhaj David.

Ayik ix jax winhaj Roboam t'a Jerusalén chi', ix smolb'an 180 mil heb' soldado winh t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' t'a yinhtilal Benjamín yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal yik smeltzajxioch heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh yalani.
Palta ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Semaías schekab' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Roboam yuninal winhaj Salomón, sreyal Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' yinhtilal Judá chi', t'a yinhtilal Benjamín yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' anima ayek' t'a skal heb':

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh eyak' owal yet' heb' eyetisraelal chi', yujto a in ix el t'a in k'ool to icha chi' tz'aji. Meltzajanhek t'a he pat, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'a winh. Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima chi', ix meltzaj heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix swach' b'oank'e chonhab' Siquem winhaj Jeroboam chi', haton ay t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ata' ix kajnaj winh. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e chonhab' Penuel winh.
Ix snaan winh icha tik: Ha tiknaik tekan ol yik'xiek' in reyal tik jun winh yinhtilal winhaj David.

Tato ol b'atnhej heb' anima tik yak' silab' t'a stemplo Jehová t'a Jerusalén, axom yak'anxioch spensar heb' t'a winhaj Roboam sreyal Judá. Ol am in smilcham heb', ol am b'atkan heb' smasanil yet' winhaj Roboam chi', xchi winh.

Axo yik ix lajwi slolon winh yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok, ix schekan winh b'ojok chab' yechel kelem wakax nab'a oro. Ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, manhxo ex b'at t'a Jerusalén. Ajaltak he b'ati, ina wal ko diosal tik, haton ik'annak onh elta t'a Egipto, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Jun yechel wakax chi' ix yak'kan winh t'a chonhab' Betel, ix yak'ankan junxo winh t'a chonhab' Dan.
Ha yuj jun chi' ix och smul heb' anima chi', yujto ix b'at heb' t'a chonhab' Dan yak'em sb'a t'a jun yechel chi'.
Ix sb'oanpaxk'e spatil sdiosal winh chi' t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh. Ix yak'anoch yopisio heb' komon anima winh t'a sakerdoteal, manh lewitaok heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh winh t'a 15 yoch swajxakil uj yik jun ab'il chi' icha jun q'uinh tzek' t'a Judá. Ix yak'ank'e silab' winh t'a yib'anh altar t'a jun yechel wakax ix sb'o winh chi' t'a chonhab' Betel. Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' sakerdote chi' winh yilumalok spatil sdiosal ix sb'o t'a juntzanh lugar chaanh.

Yuj chi' ha t'a 15 yoch swajxakil uj chi', ix yak'anoch jun q'uinh chi' winh, munil ix snaelta winh t'a yol yiko'. Ix yak'an silab' winh t'a yib'anh altar ix sb'o t'a chonhab' Betel chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix snhuspaxtz'a inkienso winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
